relations.when: microwave cavity must be opened before loading
relations.reason: Open joint makes the cavity physically accessible.

relations.when: food must be retrieved from a closed microwave
relations.reason: Open joint makes the cavity physically accessible.

relations.when: microwave food is loaded and heating is next
relations.reason: The door must be closed before the start button can heat food.

relations.when: configured food is inside the microwave
relations.reason: Start requires a closed microwave door.

relations.when: heating was started but target temperature is unmet
relations.reason: The thermal wait advances the live model and verifies the threshold.

relations.when: heated food must be removed for serving
relations.reason: Open the microwave after heating has stopped.

relations.when: retrieved food must be served upright
relations.reason: Place the still-held item and verify support and tilt.

relations.when: microwave inspection is complete without retrieval
relations.reason: Close the open door to satisfy the terminal closed condition.

relations.when: the target object is enclosed by a closed manual door or drawer
relations.reason: Open access before attempting a general pick.

relations.when: an object was removed and the manual access must be closed
relations.reason: Restore the door or drawer to its measured closed joint.

relations.when: the task requires the grasped object on a support
relations.reason: Right-hand holding is the place precondition.

relations.when: the task requires the grasped object inside a container
relations.reason: Right-hand holding is the container-place precondition.

relations.when: the task requires the object upright on a support
relations.reason: Orient before release, then verify upright after placement.

relations.when: the task requires a target area on a support
relations.reason: A held object can be placed near an xy hint.

relations.when: the task requires both upright and near-hint placement
relations.reason: Both final predicates are checked after release.

relations.when: an object was top-pinched for transfer
relations.reason: Place uses the successful right-hand grasp.

relations.when: a rim-grasped vessel must end upright on a support
relations.reason: Orient and place the held vessel.

relations.when: a rectangular-rim container was grasped for relocation
relations.reason: Relocate the held container before loading objects into it.

relations.when: a flat object needs a graspable support overhang
relations.reason: The edge exposure step verifies the overhang before the edge pick.

relations.when: the flat object is edge-held and must be placed on a shelf
relations.reason: Edge placement matches the grasp mode.

relations.when: a flat object lies on the floor and is hard to reach
relations.reason: Lowering the torso can improve floor reach.

relations.when: a floor object was lifted and needs a support
relations.reason: Place the recovered object after observing the grasp.

relations.when: a held object must be placed upright
relations.reason: The combined placement Contract checks upright again after release.

relations.when: the task needs near placement but upright is already satisfied or unnecessary
relations.reason: Use the proximity-specific contract when orientation is not part of the goal.

relations.when: the task also requires upright after release
relations.reason: Use the combined contract with both final checks.

relations.when: a carried object needs height clearance before travel
relations.reason: Raise the load before using the carry-navigation policy.

relations.when: a load needs clearance from furniture before travel
relations.reason: Back away, then select a new travel pose.

relations.when: moving pick failed and the object is stationary and reachable
relations.reason: Retry through a stationary grasp only after fresh observation.

relations.when: moving place failed and the object remains right-held
relations.reason: Try stationary support placement after fresh observation.

relations.when: top pinch geometry is absent or fails but another grasp exists
relations.reason: The general dispatcher can select another annotated grasp.

relations.when: round-rim grasp fails and the cup has an annotated handle
relations.reason: Handle grasp is a distinct physical strategy.

relations.when: the chosen container is unavailable but the task permits a support destination
relations.reason: Replan the semantic goal; do not silently weaken an inside requirement.

relations.when: the object is edge-held and surface place is unsuitable
relations.reason: Use the edge-specific place policy.

relations.when: a manual door must use an explicit handle route
relations.reason: Select the handle-specific operation when annotation supports it.

relations.when: a manual door close needs an explicit handle route
relations.reason: Select the handle-specific closure.

relations.when: a powered microwave door must close
relations.reason: Use the powered closure policy.

relations.when: manipulation used an articulated compartment and the task requires closed doors
relations.reason: Close the relevant compartment after manipulation.

relations.when: container placement used an articulated compartment and the task requires closed doors
relations.reason: Close the relevant compartment after placement.
